evidence: app/package.json:6-12 — no test script or test runner dependency at all
app/src/routes/+page.server.js:59-80 — filtering, search and pagination clamping (high-risk) have no tests
coverage_of_risk.rationale: No tests exist in app/, and the codebase is full of exactly the risky logic (URL state, pagination, sorting, data merging) that tests should concentrate on.

behaviour_not_implementation.rationale: There are no tests, behavioural or otherwise; the rubric floors this at 1.

evidence: app/src/lib/format.js:17-25 — latestEnglishFlavorText whitespace collapse would regress silently
app/src/routes/pokemon/[name]/+page.server.js:97-101 — per-move dedupe drops second level_learned_at; nothing would catch a regression
app/src/routes/+page.svelte:37-55 — debounce/pending/URL merge has known race-prone logic with no test
regression_power.rationale: With zero tests, any behaviour can be broken without a failing test; nothing would be caught.

evidence: app/ — zero test files, so no noise, but also no signal
signal_to_noise.rationale: No low-value tests because there are no tests; per the rubric this is a neutral 3.

findings.issue: No test script, no test runner, and zero test files; the app leans entirely on the acceptance suite in tests/
findings.suggestion: Add vitest for pure logic (format.js, pokeapi.js, the load functions' filtering/pagination) and a couple of Playwright component/E2E tests for URL-state sync and table sorting

findings.issue: buildCards' hidden-vs-non-hidden dedupe is order-sensitive and untested; a refactor could silently drop '(hidden)' markers or duplicate cards
findings.suggestion: Unit-test buildCards against fixture refs including hidden-then-normal and normal-then-hidden ordering, plus ID > 10000 exclusion

findings.issue: Per-method move dedupe keeps only the first level_learned_at; a move learnable at two levels loses a row and nothing would catch it
findings.suggestion: Add a load-function test with a Pokémon fixture having duplicate version_group_details entries

findings.issue: Pagination clamp (NaN, out-of-range page) and the 48-per-page slice are untested; off-by-one bugs would ship silently
findings.suggestion: Test the load function with url params page=0, page=999, page=abc, and a boundary count of exactly 48/49

findings.issue: Client-side column sorting (missing-last in both directions, aria-sort, numeric localeCompare) is completely untested
findings.suggestion: Add a component test that clicks headers and asserts rendered row order and aria-sort for the null-power and duplicate-name edge cases

findings.issue: Debounce timer, pending flag and commit() override merging can race (e.g. typing then immediately changing type); no tests
findings.suggestion: E2E or component tests with fake timers covering type-while-searching, back-to-page-1 on filter change, and URL parameter omission at defaults

findings.issue: latestEnglishFlavorText's reverse iteration and \s+/\f collapse, plus humanize/dexNumber, are the app's most-reused pure functions and have no unit tests
findings.suggestion: A handful of vitest cases with real-shaped flavor_text_entries fixtures (including \f and non-English entries)

findings.issue: memo caches resolved 404-nulls forever and eviction only happens on rejection; a key-format or transient-failure regression would serve stale nulls silently
findings.suggestion: Unit-test the cache with a stubbed fetchJson covering 404, failure-then-retry, and key stability

findings.issue: 404 paths (error() vs throw) and the +error.svelte boundary are untested; refactors could turn styled 404s into crashes
findings.suggestion: One E2E test per route family hitting a bogus :name and asserting the 404 page renders with the required landmarks

summary: The agent wrote zero tests of its own — no runner, no script, no test files in app/ — while the app contains dense, easily-unit-testable risky logic (pagination, filtering, sorting, hidden-ability merging, URL state). The acceptance suite was the only guard, so any refactor of the data layer would currently ship unverified. Adding vitest for the pure functions and load functions plus a few sorting/URL-state component tests would cover most of the risk cheaply.
